title: HOOP test error catalog taxonomy
purpose: Closed, single-label rules for classifying records from test_error_messages.json

handoff_fields.original_message: string|null; derived by the source-catalog handoff

input.preservation: Never drop, deduplicate, or rewrite source identity fields. Derived fields are added or replaced only according to this taxonomy.

authentication.description: Identity, credential, token, or login verification

authorization.description: Permission, access, forbidden, or explicit confirmation checks

concurrency.description: Tasks, locks, races, cancellation, shutdown, or reconnect coordination

configuration.description: Configuration files, CLI flags, adapters, models, settings, or wizard behavior

filesystem.description: Files, directories, paths, local file I/O, or workspace filesystem state

network.description: HTTP, WebSocket, sockets, ports, endpoints, requests, or transport communication

parsing.description: Parsing, serialization, deserialization, encoding, malformed input, or structured output

persistence.description: SQLite, databases, audit rows, migrations, backups, restore, or durable storage

performance.description: Load, latency, throughput, percentile, slowness, or performance-budget checks

resource.description: Creation, lookup, or lifecycle of a domain resource when no more specific subsystem applies

runtime.description: Daemon, process, subprocess, service, command execution, or standard-stream lifecycle

security.description: Secrets, redaction, sensitive data, traversal, privacy, or credential exposure

state.description: Events, beads, Stitches, workers, sessions, claims, projections, or domain state

timeout.description: Timeouts, elapsed deadlines, readiness waits, or failure to become ready

validation.description: Expected values, invariants, required fields, equality, mismatch, or generic assertion outcomes

other.description: Unknown, empty, generic, or ambiguous messages with no determinable supported category

rules.when: original_message is a non-null, non-empty string
rules.value: Use original_message exactly after JSON/string unescaping; do not inspect unrelated literals in source_text.

rules.when: original_message is null and source_text contains an expectation or error macro with string literals
rules.value: Use the final string literal, matching the preceding handoff validator behavior.

rules.when: original_message is null and source_text contains assert_eq! or assert_ne!
rules.value: Use string literals in the third and later macro arguments only; a value-only assertion has an empty message.
Use the empty string for message-rule matching, retain the record, and retain/add the no_original_message exception flag.

message_extraction.matching: All message patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions applied only to the extracted message text. A pattern either matches or does not; there is no scoring or confidence threshold.

message_rules.pattern: forbidden|unauthori[sz]|permission denied|access denied|not allowed|must confirm|confirm requirement
timeout|timed out|within \d+ seconds|within timeout|did not become ready|failed to become ready|waiting for|wait for

source_file_fallback.applies_after: All message rules have failed to match.
source_file_fallback.only_when: The message is empty, generic, or has no supported semantic signal.
source_file_fallback.ambiguity: Collect the distinct categories matched by the source_file rules. Apply the single category only when exactly one distinct category matches. If zero or more than one category matches, return other. Never resolve conflicting file hints by rule order.

when: message text is unknown, empty, generic, or ambiguous
no message rule matches and source_file provides no unique fallback category
source_file is malformed or cannot be normalized
fallback.prohibition: Do not add an error type outside allowed_error_types to represent uncertainty.

steps: Replace backslash separators with forward slashes.
Remove exactly one trailing .rs suffix from the file name.
Replace every hyphen in every path segment with an underscore.
Join the remaining non-empty path segments with ::.
Preserve case and all other characters; do not collapse lib.rs or mod.rs, because the source file remains the grouping identity.
source_module_normalization.invalid_input: Use source_module=unknown_module, retain source_file unchanged, and add an exception flag; do not invent a module from an absolute path or a path containing .. segments.

invariants: Every retained record receives exactly one error_type from allowed_error_types.
Every retained valid source record receives exactly one deterministic source_module.
A record is never assigned more than one error_type; precedence selects the first matching message rule.
The extractor category field is metadata and is never used as an error_type.
Original message, file, line, category, line_content, and unrelated input fields remain unchanged.
